Pani.information: Gandum mein pani ki zaroorat fasal ki halat aur ilaqay ke mutabiq dekhi jati hai. Pani ki kami wheat production ko kam kar sakti hai.
Pani.source: Pakistan Agricultural Research Council (PARC) - Wheat Program

Khaad.information: Gandum mein khaad ka istemal fasal ki zaroorat aur input management ke mutabiq karna chahiye.
Khaad.source: Punjab Agriculture Department - Wheat Research Institute

Bimari.information: Gandum mein rust, smut, bunt, blast aur kuch viral diseases aham bimariyon mein shamil hain. Bimari ki sahi pehchan ke liye nishaniyan check karna zaroori hai.
Bimari.source: Punjab Agriculture Department - Wheat Research Institute

Growth.information: Gandum ki behtar paidawar ke liye waqt par kasht, munasib input management, pani aur weeds ka control important hain.
Growth.source: Pakistan Agricultural Research Council (PARC) - Wheat Program
